name: wildcard-permitted-outer-too-broad-invalid
description: A wildcard SAN whose expansions include hosts outside the permitted DNS subtree must be rejected: permitted foo.example.com cannot allow *.example.com because *.example.com expands to bar.example.com.
references: Go name_constraints_test "outer wildcard names are not matched by subdomain permitted constraints"
notes: RFC 5280 does not define wildcard SAN semantics; this targets Go's application DNS-ID name-constraint behavior.
